subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should unified usage and spend become a permanent top-level Settings destination, or should the submitted aggregation be presented inside the existing shared overview?
rationale: The implementation is technically credible, but VISION.md explicitly reserves new product surfaces and meaningful maintenance commitments for sign-off.

options.title: Integrate shared overview
options.body: Keep the aggregation and proof-backed behavior but place it in the existing overview to minimize top-level Settings growth.

options.title: Approve dedicated pane
options.body: Accept Usage & Spend as a permanent top-level destination with its own navigation and localization maintenance.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the dashboard until a broader Settings information architecture or analytics direction is established.

recommendation.title: Integrate shared overview
recommendation.body: Keep the aggregation and proof-backed behavior but place it in the existing overview to minimize top-level Settings growth.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the repository vision and current Settings direction and was explicitly asked to decide placement.
